claims.statement: createGitHubWebhookRoutes is mounted at /github/webhook before express.json() in packages/server/src/index.ts because the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC authenticates exact wire bytes; the router applies a 60 req/min rate limiter then express.raw with a 256kb cap so req.body stays a Buffer, and the handler rejects non-Buffer bodies with 400 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_RAW_BODY_REQUIRED and returns 503 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_UNCONFIGURED when GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset.

Signature verification requires the X-Hub-Signature-256 header to match ^sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}$ and compares the HMAC-sha256 of the raw body against it with crypto.timingSafeEqual (constant-time), rejecting with 401 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID.

Repository allowlist: configuredRepository() parses GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PATHS as JSON mapping repository full_name to local paths, accepting only absolute, existing directories and returning the realpathSync-resolved path; any failure yields 422 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_REPOSITORY_UNCONFIGURED.

The issues branch only accepts actions opened and labeled (zod issuePayload); a labeled event is ignored with 202 label_not_selected unless the label equals GITHUB_LOOP_LABEL (default djimitflo), and unsupported X-GitHub-Event types get 202 ignored/unsupported_event.

Issue intake imports exactly one triaged work item via IntegrationInboxService.importEvent (source github_issue, recommended_loop repo-maintenance-loop, value_score default 85 for github_issue), wraps issue content in a BEGIN_EXTERNAL_CONTENT trust=untrusted fence as a prompt-injection defense, derives risk_class from labels (critical/sev1/p0→critical, high/sev2/p1→high, medium/p2→medium, else low), and responds execution_started: false with operator_review_required: true — the connector never starts goals, loops, or workers for issues.

Re-delivery of the same issue under a new delivery ID goes through WorkItemService.upsertBySourceRef, which refreshes title/description/metadata and only raises risk_class while preserving operator-owned state (status, assigned_runtime, assigned_agent_id, parent_goal_id, recommended_loop).

The pull_request branch (actions opened/synchronize/reopened) runs a single immediate SQLite transaction that creates a goal with the untrusted-content-wrapped objective, starts a repo-maintenance-loop run whose target_finding file_path is a stable anchor file (first present of package.json/README.md/AGENTS.md, else 422 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_NO_ANCHOR_FILE), and records the delivery; GithubPrReviewService.startReview is called only after the transaction commits because shelling to gh must never happen inside it.

Every processed delivery is persisted in github_webhook_deliveries (id, event, source_ref, result_json, payload_sha256) keyed by the X-GitHub-Delivery header; an identical redelivery replays the stored response with 200 status duplicate, while a delivery ID rebound to different event/source_ref/payload hash or missing result yields 409 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_CONFLICT.

GithubPrReviewService maintains github_pull_request_reviews with a unique index on (owner, repo, pr_number, head_sha) and status pending/commented/completed/failed; startReview never throws — gh or GitHub failures are recorded as status failed with a github_pr_review_failed audit entry and the webhook still answers 202, keeping the local DB authoritative, while a successful review writes a github_pr_reviewed success audit entry.

Phase 1 (default, no LLM) synthesizes an already-completed manual maker lease (the PR's commits are the patch, no worktree) and a manual checker lease driving the real LoopService.submitCheckerVerdict with a manual_attestation; the verdict is a rule-based stub over gh pr view stats — >40 files or >1500 changed lines or paths matching /.env|secret|credential/i yield needs_revision, otherwise accepted. The worktree-less bookkeeping run is no longer left blocked: verification marks the worktree/diff gates skipped (E2), the GitHub-posted verdict is computed independently of the loop outcome, and after a successful comment settleReviewRun sets the loop_run to completed with metadata settled_by='github-pr-review' and idempotently completes any still-running goals of already-settled review runs.

Phase 2 (opt-in via GITHUB_PR_REVIEW_RUNTIME set to codex/opencode/claude/gemini/editor/mock) returns pending immediately and asynchronously fetches pull/<n>/head, materializes a real worktree on a djimitflo/pr-review-<n>-<lease-id-prefix> branch reset to the head SHA, writes gh pr diff into .djimitflo/PR_REVIEW_PACKET.md wrapped as untrusted external content (the first point an LLM reads PR data), and drives a real checker through LoopService.executeChecker with a 480s timeout; runLlmReview never throws to its caller (failure rows and audit are updated directly) and settles the run completed on success; it is off by default to avoid auto-spawning paid LLM calls on every PR push.

postToGithub writes the markdown comment (verdict line, diff stats, loop run ID, optional roborev static-findings section matched on owner/repo at head SHA) to a temp file posted via gh pr comment --body-file, then sets a Commit Status via gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/statuses/{head_sha} with context djimitflo-review because the Checks API rejects personal-access-token auth with a hard 403; all gh calls use a 15s timeout.

Because GithubPrReviewService shells out to gh for PR comments and commit statuses, the production Dockerfile runner stage installs the OS packages ca-certificates, git, python3-minimal, curl, procps, and libatomic1 via apt after a bounded-retry IPv4 apt config (Dockerfile L59–L67), then installs the GitHub CLI from a statically fetched, pinned .deb — ARG GH_CLI_VERSION=2.100.0, downloaded from github.com/cli/cli/releases for the dpkg build architecture with curl retry flags, installed with dpkg -i, and verified with gh --version at build time (L69–L77) — rather than adding a third-party apt repository; an inline comment names GithubPrReviewService as the consumer.

After the loop daemon's verification pass finds all gates passing (step 9b, inside the allGatesPass learning-loop closure), it calls LoopDraftPrService.openForRun for the certified run; the call is wrapped so a PR failure never fails the daemon, and the service itself returns null unless LOOP_AUTO_DRAFT_PR_ENABLED is exactly 'true', requires GITHUB_REPOSITORY/GITHUB_TOKEN (their absence is recorded as a draft_pr_failed warning event with a null return), keeping the GitHub-publishing hand-off opt-in by default.

LoopDraftPrService opens at most one draft PR per run and targets the right repo: it only acts on loop_runs in status ready_for_human_merge or completed, returns an already-recorded loop_runs.metadata.pr_url unchanged when present, derives the target slug from the linked proposal's repo:<slug> evidence ref (falling back to the primary GITHUB_REPOSITORY), refuses unregistered extra-repo goals with draft_pr_failed: repo_not_registered, requires the worktree's push-remote URL to parse back to the same slug (repo_mismatch otherwise, nothing pushed), and converts every missing precondition or GitHub failure into a draft_pr_failed warning loop event with a null return instead of throwing.

The draft-PR push commits only the maker's real files from the latest non-superseded completed maker lease's worktree — tracked diffs plus untracked files, excluding node_modules content, symlinks, and lockfile install noise (a package-lock.json whose sibling package.json was untouched) — failing with 'no changes in the maker worktree' if nothing qualifies, commits under the djimitflo-loop identity, and authenticates the push with the token as a one-off http.extraheader basic-auth header so the token is never written to the remote URL or .git/config and is scrubbed from any recorded error message.

The draft PR is opened via POST api.github.com/repos/{target-repo}/pulls with draft: true, base branch LOOP_DRAFT_PR_BASE (default main), push remote LOOP_DRAFT_PR_REMOTE (default origin), a 120-char-capped 'loop:'-prefixed title taken from the linked self-improvement proposal when the goal has one (else 'run <id-prefix>'), and a body listing the recorded checker/security_checker verdicts and the file list — optionally enriched behind LOOP_PR_BODY_V2 with lane, oracle checks, gate summary, diff stat, mutation score and an https-only run link, secret-redacted because the repo is public; on success the PR URL is persisted into loop_runs.metadata.pr_url and a draft_pr_opened loop event is recorded.

Before publishing, openForRun can run the Batch-8 evidence-freshness gate: with LOOP_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS_MODE shadow|enforce it re-fingerprints the maker lease's recorded evidence_read_set (files the checks READ but did not edit) against freshly fetched current main (FETCH_HEAD of LOOP_DRAFT_PR_BASE), persists the fresh/stale/unknown result into loop_runs.metadata.evidence_freshness, records evidence_stale / evidence_stale_shadow events, and in enforce mode marks the run with a requeue metadata flag and returns null instead of opening the PR; a failed base fetch fails open as 'unknown'.

The RX-6 arrival throttle caps open loop-authored PRs: with LOOP_DRAFT_PR_THROTTLE_MODE shadow|enforce the service counts open GitHub PRs titled 'loop:' against LOOP_DRAFT_PR_MAX_OPEN (default 5); at or over the cap enforce mode records draft_pr_throttled and opens nothing while shadow records draft_pr_throttle_shadow and opens anyway, and a failing open-PR list call never throttles (fail-open), so an undrained queue does not censor merge-survival signal.

The service file also exports cockpit read models over loop_runs.metadata.pr_url without any GitHub call: listDraftPrs folds merge-survival's polled pr_outcome and auto_merge decision into per-row evolutionary settlement states plus unsettled/closed_unmerged aggregate counts (failing soft to null totals on a partial schema and excluding registered-extra-repo PRs from the default view), and countOpenLoopPrs returns the needs-you count of open loop PRs, likewise null — 'unknown', not zero — on a schema failure.
